messages:
Maya Chen: uploaded a new figma and a quick prototype — thinking about the trace viewer action bar. primary action order is confusing on narrow widths. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/trace-ux

Jon Park: Quick glance — the export icon is visually dominant. Are we trying to encourage exports? For support flows i think copy-id should be first.

Priya Singh: Agreed. Support uses copy-id + paste into Zendesk all the time. Metrics: copy-id triggered ≈68% of action clicks in beta. Export triggered ~9% (per Noah's analytics).

Rob Diaz: +1 to making copy-id first. Also we should keep a visible label on mobile; icon-only gets lost.

Ava Li: Accessibility nit: icon buttons need aria-label and visible focus. Also keyboard nav order must match visual order. Currently tab order goes export -> copy.

Maya Chen: Proposed layout: left: 'Copy request ID' (primary), center: 'Copy URL' (secondary), right: kebab for export/share. On small screens we collapse less-used actions into the kebab. Thoughts?

Jon Park: Would be worried about extra taps on mobile. Maybe collapse into a single 'Copy' dropdown with options for ID vs URL, keep kebab for export.

Priya Singh: Dropdown increases clicks for the most common action though — that's a regression for support.

Maya Chen: Alternative: show full 'Copy request ID' button >=600px, icon-only with accessible label and visible focus <600px. Also keep an analytics event for every tap.

Ava Li: Tooltips alone aren't accessible. Need aria-describedby + focusable label, and test with VoiceOver/JAWS. Also ensure focus ring is visible on contrast-mode.

Rob Diaz: Implementation note: backend currently exposes correlation id at span level as 'corr_id' — need to standardize to 'correlation_id' for copy payloads. Filed issue: #3421.

Maya Chen: Small copy question: 'Copy request ID' vs 'Copy correlation ID' — which communicates better to support?

Priya Singh: Users say 'request id' more often in tickets. Use 'Request ID'.

Jon Park: Microcopy: sentence case, no trailing punctuation. 'Copy request ID' fits.

Ava Li: Also add an accessible export confirmation dialog copy: 'Exporting may include sensitive data. Continue?' and ensure default focus on Cancel.

Maya Chen: I'll push updated mock + a11y checklist later today and tag you all. Putting the new layout in the spike branch.

DesignBot: Checklist updated: a11y (aria-labels, focus order, tooltips), analytics event names (copy_request_id, export_request_trace), copy wording. Doc: https://internal.docs/trace-actions

Priya Singh: :thumbsup:

Rob Diaz: merging with my issue, will update API by EOD.

Jon Park: I'll create a sprint ticket and assign frontend. thanks everyone!
